![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

To fully adhere to the design goal of ensuring the hydrated registry map uses a `null` prototype (preventing prototype pollution and inheritance issues), the fallback value should be initialized with `Object.create(null)` instead of `{}`.

```suggestion
  const spe956SurvivorInformalRegistryRecords = sanitizeSpe956SurvivorInformalRegistryRecords(
    game.spe956SurvivorInformalRegistryRecords,
    fallback.spe956SurvivorInformalRegistryRecords ?? Object.create(null)
  )
```
